summary: Frontend-only visual redesign test for Ana Dashboard (premium hero band + delta badges). All acceptance criteria pass: hero band, 4 primary KPIs with values exactly matching /api/dashboard/summary, secondary StatCards & cashflow cards rendering with /api/dashboard/insights and /api/cashflow/summary values, delta badge rules (none on 'Tüm Zamanlar', 'Yeni' on 'Bu Ay' because 2026-09-19..30 has no data, no badge when both current+previous are zero, no margin-pp badge when previous revenue=0), charts render with SVG & '-$280' style negative Y-axis labels, store/marketplace/currency filters work, quick-action links navigate, /cashflow page (KpiCard component) is visually unaffected, and 390px viewport shows no horizontal overflow.

issues: Recharts emits repeated console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' during initial mount of ResponsiveContainer. Non-blocking (charts render correctly) but noisy. Consider setting minHeight on wrapper divs or using <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%"> with explicit parent height already provided (currently h-64 is set but warning still fires on first paint). Low priority.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Suppress Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) initial-mount warnings by ensuring ResponsiveContainer parent has non-zero size on first render (e.g. render charts only when data length determined, or set explicit minHeight).
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardHero.jsx & DashboardCharts.jsx are small, well-structured, use data-testid, and avoid data mutation — redesign is strictly presentational as intended.
Dashboard.jsx correctly fetches a parallel 'previous period' snapshot only when a date range is active, and resets prev to null on 'Tüm Zamanlar' — matches spec.
Delta rules in delta()/DeltaBadge match the spec exactly (pp for margin, 'Yeni' for prev=0 with non-zero current, null when both zero, inverse for expenses).
No KpiCard usage was changed; /cashflow page renders without regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard visual redesign fully verified. API values verified to match UI: revenue $70.27, expenses $350.00, net_profit -$279.73, margin -398.1%. On 'Bu Ay' preset (today=2026-10-12), previous range resolves to 2026-09-19..2026-09-30 which has no data, so revenue/expenses/net_profit/cf-period-in/cf-period-out/cf-net badges show 'Yeni' (6 badges). margin, fba, fbm, fba-inventory, orders, amazon-balance, cf-capital-tied have no badge (both zero or prev-revenue zero rule) — this is correct per spec.
